Method of Attack: The malware uses a PDF file to distribute the downloader, which then downloads and executes additional components.
It uses DLL-hijacking to run require.exe, which in turn downloads the main module (chrome.exe).

Byakugan can perform screen monitoring using OBS Studio, take screenshots using Windows APIs, mine cryptocurrency, log keystrokes, manipulate files, steal browser information, and inject cookies into specified browsers.
It has anti-analysis features to avoid detection and sets persistence mechanisms to ensure it runs at startup.
Attack Vector: Phishing attack via a PDF file with a malicious link.
